scope: post-update oracle diagnostic; no prospective forecasting claim
gate: Both controllers complete before any new likelihood reading; full original-host integrity audit required. No new diagnostic outcome has been inspected when writing this plan.

grid.comparisons: direct SNIS versus all six saved Taylor representations, both linear and SNIS, including zero
grid.subgroups: all styles, each style, every batch; same-question and calibration-mean template transfer

weighting: Keep original frozen proposal density q. Baseline rescores audit numerical drift only. Direct change subtracts original-bank weighted baseline.

uncertainty.proposals: Resample within temperature and nested fixed strata 0:64,64:128,128:256,256:320,320:384,384:512. Same draws across banks and estimators. Conditional on subset partition.
uncertainty.evaluation: Resample 128 responses separately from proposals, paired baseline/update streams for all conditions; crossed question sampling within template and style-stratified batch sampling.
uncertainty.report: Pointwise descriptive intervals, no population or multiplicity-adjusted success claims; absent proposal events remain absent in bootstrap.

diagnostics: raw and centered direct-versus-Taylor log-ratio errors
ESS relative to N/4, minimum/p10/median, mean-weight normalization, maximum weight concentration
all bank/question event coverage, no exclusion
pooled error, absolute magnitude, normalized errors, worst batch and tails
examples: Previously generated mixture responses only: batches 0..3, probes 0 and 8, sample 0, all rates and both seeds.
decision: If direct weights still fail large-step behavior, stop incremental proposal changes as the proposed route to large-step reliability; develop a predictor able to represent newly generated trajectories. Any new method needs a separate frozen development phase before fresh confirmation.
